tools.name: chain_info
tools.description: Chain id, latest block number, gas price and base fee for the connected outbe-chain node.

tools.name: block_get
tools.description: Fetch a block by number or tag (default latest). Pass `block` as a number, hex, or 'latest'/'finalized'.

tools.name: transaction_get
tools.description: Fetch a transaction by hash.

tools.name: transaction_receipt_get
tools.description: Fetch a transaction receipt by hash, including status (success/reverted), gas used and logs.

tools.name: contract_call
tools.description: Call any view/pure method on an outbe precompile and get decoded, human-readable output. `contract` is a registry name (tribute, tributefactory, nod, gratis, gratisfactory, promis, promislimit, gem, gemfactory, credis, credisfactory, vaultrouter, agentreward, fidelity, metadosis, oracle, staking, validatorset, slashindicator, zerofee, teeregistry, governance) or a 0x address. `method` is the function name; `args` are its arguments in order (numbers/strings).

tools.name: tribute_get
tools.description: Tribute metadata by token id: owner + decoded attributes (worldwide_day, currency, amounts).

id.description: Tribute token id as a uint256 (decimal or 0x hex)

tools.name: tributes_by_owner
tools.description: List Tribute token ids owned by an address.

tools.name: tributes_by_day
tools.description: List Tribute token ids recorded for a WorldwideDay.

tools.name: worldwide_day_totals
tools.description: Aggregate Tribute totals for a WorldwideDay (count, nominal amount, sealed).

tools.name: nod_get
tools.description: Nod NFT data by token id (decoded) plus parsed tokenURI metadata.

id.description: Nod token id as a uint256 (decimal or 0x hex)

tools.name: nods_by_owner
tools.description: List Nod token ids owned by an address (Nod has no bulk getter, so this enumerates balanceOf -> tokenOfOwnerByIndex).

tools.name: gem_get
tools.description: Gem NFT status by token id (decoded: type, state, load, prices, currency, issued), whether it has qualified (born so, or derived from finalized daily VWAPs) plus parsed tokenURI metadata.

tools.name: gem_position_get
tools.description: Gem Factory position terms by id: merchant, source series, remaining capacity, the entry/floor prices its gems are anchored to, both currencies and when it was opened.

tools.name: gem_settle_quote
tools.description: What settling a gem with a given asset costs, and which of the gem's two currencies that asset settles on. `paymentMinor` is in the asset's own minor units; `snapshotId` is the trailing VWAP snapshot an issuance-currency settlement must name (zero on the reference rail). An issuance-currency quote expires at the next whole UTC hour.

asset.description: Settlement stablecoin the holder intends to pay with

tools.name: gems_by_owner
tools.description: List Gems owned by an address with decoded status for each (Gem has no bulk getter, so this enumerates balanceOf -> tokenOfOwnerByIndex -> getGemStatus).

tools.name: credis_position_get
tools.description: Credis position by id (decoded: principal, outstanding, Gratis, prices, state) plus parsed tokenURI metadata.

tools.name: gratis_balance
tools.description: Encrypted Gratis liquid and pledged balances; decrypt both locally with the account view key.

tools.name: promis_balance
tools.description: Encrypted Promis balance; decrypt it locally with the account's Promis view key.

tools.name: fidelity_max_index
tools.description: Public synthetic-maximum Fidelity Index (saturating RCFI ceiling) at a Unix timestamp, in decayed days.

tools.name: agentreward_claimable
tools.description: Claimable AgentReward balance for an account (in COEN), all three pools summed.

tools.name: agentreward_pool_claimable
tools.description: Claimable AgentReward balance for an account in one pool (0 = WAA, 1 = SRA, 2 = CCA), in COEN.

tools.name: worldwide_days_offering
tools.description: WorldwideDays currently in OFFERING status (the days a tribute offer can target).

tools.name: worldwide_day_get
tools.description: Full lifecycle state of a WorldwideDay (status, type, period timestamps, VWAP).

tools.name: currency_pairs
tools.description: All oracle price pairs (index, base, quote, the decimals each side is quoted in, active).

tools.name: currency_rate
tools.description: Latest exchange rate for a base/quote pair.

tools.name: currency_rate_vwap
tools.description: VWAP for a base/quote pair. With lookback_seconds uses the rolling window; otherwise the day VWAP.

tools.name: validators
tools.description: Active validator set + counts and current epoch.

tools.name: validator_get
tools.description: Full validator record by address (stake, status, miss counters, epoch heights).

tools.name: staking_info
tools.description: Stake delegated to a validator and total staked.

tools.name: metacanon_get
tools.description: The meta-canon: current text + version + keccak hash (constitutional layer regulating the canon).

tools.name: canon_get
tools.description: The canon: current text + version + keccak hash (active protocol norms).

tools.name: oip_get
tools.description: One Outbe Improvement Proposal by id: author, status, blocks, text hash, and full text.

tools.name: gip_get
tools.description: One Governance Improvement Proposal by id: author, status, blocks, text hash, and full text.

tools.name: oip_list
tools.description: List OIPs by index, paginated (metadata only - omits the full text). Give `author` (their OIPs) or `status` (a proposal status name), plus optional `offset`/`limit`.

status.description: proposal status: Draft | Approved | Rejected | Rework | Implemented

tools.name: gip_list
tools.description: List GIPs by index, paginated (metadata only - omits the full text). Give `author` (their GIPs) or `status` (a proposal status name), plus optional `offset`/`limit`.

status.description: proposal status: Draft | Approved | Rejected | Rework | Implemented

tools.name: credis_reserve
tools.description: Reserve exact stablecoin principal and freeze the Credis terms for 15 minutes. Returns the reservationId.

source.description: Main account that pledges the Gratis collateral

tools.name: gratis_pledge
tools.description: Pledge the reservation's Gratis from the caller, its source. The mac binds Pledge and the reservation's gratisMinor.

tools.name: gratis_cancel_pledge
tools.description: Return an unused reservation pledge to the caller's liquid Gratis.

tools.name: credis_issue
tools.description: Issue Credis against the reservation's pledge and deliver the reserved principal. The CCA stakes native COEN equal to the reserved Gratis collateral; omit `stake` to use exactly that. Returns the positionId.

stake.description: amount in whole COEN, e.g. "100" or "1.5"

tools.name: credis_settle
tools.description: Repay a position; released collateral returns to the source's liquid Gratis. Approves CredisFactory for `amount` of the position's asset first when the allowance is short.

tools.name: tribute_offer
tools.description: Encrypt and submit a Tribute offer. Reads the DKG-derived offer key from the TeeRegistry, auto-detects the OFFERING WorldwideDay if not given, encrypts the payload (X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + ChaCha20Poly1305) and sends offerTribute. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY and the ZK offer inputs: a combined proof, its Merkle root and the L2 BLS signature over it, the circuit chain/version the proof verifies under, plus the tribute_draft_id / su_hashes / amount the proof binds (the enclave folds them into the nft_hash checked against the proof). No proof is generated here - produce it on the L2. Note: token id is derived from (caller, worldwide_day), so one tribute per account per day.

amount_micro.description: six-decimal remainder matching the proof's draft (default "0")

exclude_from_intex_issuance.description: exclude the resulting Tribute from Intex issuance (default false)

zk_proof.description: combined Tribute proof bytes (0x-hex): 4-byte public-input word count, public inputs, then proof

zk_merkle_root.description: L2 Merkle root the proof's public input commits to; also checked against the L2 BLS signature

signature.description: BLS MinSig signature (compressed G1, 48 bytes) over zk_merkle_root by the network key registered in the L2Registry

l2_chain_id.description: L2 chain id the offer's proof verifies under; must be the caller's registered L2

circuit_version.description: exact circuit version enabled for that L2 chain, e.g. "1.1.0"

tribute_draft_id.description: 32-byte TributeDraft id bound by the proof and by the caller's L2 attestation

items.description: 32-byte SpendingUnit hash bound by the proof

su_hashes.description: SpendingUnit hashes bound by the proof

tools.name: staking_stake
tools.description: Stake COEN to a validator. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

amount.description: amount in whole COEN, e.g. "100" or "1.5"

tools.name: staking_unstake
tools.description: Unstake COEN (starts unbonding). Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

amount.description: amount in whole COEN, e.g. "100" or "1.5"

tools.name: staking_unbonded_claim
tools.description: Claim unbonded stake after the unbonding period. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

tools.name: agentreward_claim
tools.description: Claim AgentReward from one pool (0 = WAA, 1 = SRA, 2 = CCA) as a Gem. Omit amount to claim the whole pool balance. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

amount.description: amount to claim; omit for the whole balance

tools.name: oracle_feeder_delegate
tools.description: Delegate oracle feeder consent to an address. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY (validator).

tools.name: oracle_vote_submit
tools.description: Submit oracle exchange-rate votes. `tuples`: [{base, quote, exchangeRate, volume}] with rate/volume as integer minor strings (COEN/ISO rates use scale 1e6; generic pairs keep their existing scale). Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY (validator).

tools.name: intent_order_open
tools.description: Open a cross-chain intent order on the intent Router (ERC-7683 `open`). Pulls/approves the input ERC20 (or sends native value), deposits into The Compact, returns the deterministic orderId. `amount_in`/`amount_out` are whole-token decimals; input decimals are read on origin and output decimals on destination (override with `output_decimals`). Tokens are symbols or 0x addresses. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

origin.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

input_token.description: token: symbol (USD, COEN, ...) or a 0x address

amount_in.description: input amount in whole tokens, e.g. "10" or "1.5"

tools.name: intent_order_track
tools.description: Where an order is in its cross-chain lifecycle, as a deterministic snapshot (no event scan). Reads origin/destination status and derives a coarse `phase` (OPENED -> CLAIMED -> FILLED -> SETTLED, plus REFUNDED/EXPIRED) with a `next` hint. Poll it (e.g. via /loop) to follow progress.

chain.description: network where the order was opened (origin)

tools.name: intent_order_refund
tools.description: Refund an expired, still-OPENED order, returning the input back to the sender. Calls `refund` on the destination router; cross-chain refunds pay the bridge messaging fee (quoted automatically), same-chain refunds are free. Reverts if the order is not OPENED or the deadline has not passed. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

chain.description: network where the order was opened (origin)

tools.name: intex_series_info
tools.description: Canonical series record from the outbe Intex: promis load, entry/floor/call prices, currencies, lifecycle state (Issued/Qualified/Called/Expired), whether it has qualified (derived from finalized daily VWAPs, never stored), issued/called timestamps, the settlementDeadline and the derived `expired` flag - check `expired` before attempting settle (past-deadline settles revert) - and how the issued units split into active, settled, exercised, sent to the Gem Factory and forfeited.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_series_list
tools.description: Enumerate series ids that exist in the outbe Intex (dense enumeration).

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_holdings_by_owner
tools.description: Intex NFT holdings for an address: owned token ids, balances, decoded status (Issued/Settled), and for Issued ones the series lifecycle with its settlementDeadline and, on outbe, whether it has qualified. Defaults to bsc-testnet (where won NFTs land); pass network to read outbe. A holding away from outbe cannot be settled where it sits - bridge it over with intex_bridge_send before the deadline shown here.

account.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_series_balance
tools.description: An address's Intex NFT balance for one series, split into issued and settled token ids. Reads the chain you ask for; settlement only happens on outbe, so an issued balance found elsewhere has to be bridged over before the series settlementDeadline (intex_series_info shows it).

account.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auctions_active
tools.description: Active Intex auctions and their stage. Auction ids are worldwide days (yyyymmdd); probes a date window (default today-30..+2, override via from_date/to_date). Active = CommittingBids or RevealingBids; pass include_all for every stage.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_info
tools.description: One auction's stage, schedule (commit/reveal/issuance ends in UTC), and params (promis-load strike, min bid rate/units, and one entry/floor/call row per currency the day prices - bid in one of those). Bids are sealed: the bid counts and clearing result stay 0 until clearing runs after reveal, so 0 here does NOT mean there are no participants.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_chains
tools.description: Per-chain bid fan-in for one auction day, read from outbe: the day's target-chain snapshot and, for each chain, whether its bids arrived in full (BIDS_DONE) and how many. Clearing runs once every chain reports or the fan-in deadline passes; a chain still done=false after clearing was skipped and its bidders reclaim locally (see auction_bids_by_owner on that chain).

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_bids_by_owner
tools.description: Your commit/reveal status across recent auctions, closed days included, plus your escrow money on that chain: the commit bond (held from commit until reveal/cancel) and the bid lock (held from reveal until you claim). Every bid ends in a claim - a winner's change, a loser's whole principal - so the lock reports what auction_claim_refund pays and from when. Pass worldwideDay to check just one.

account.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_bid_commit
tools.description: Commit a sealed Intex bid: signs the EIP-712 RevealBid and submits keccak256(signature) as the commit hash (no separate salt). When the auction carries an entry bond (commitBondMinor > 0), commitBid pulls it into escrow in the same transaction - the tool auto-approves the escrow if the allowance is short. The bond returns at reveal/cancel; a green-day no-reveal locks it for 24 hours past revealEnd (intex_claim_commit_bond). IMPORTANT: save your (worldwideDay, units, rate, currencies); you must repeat them to reveal, they can't be recovered on-chain, and are only remembered this session. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

rate.description: bid rate as a fraction of strike, 0..1 (e.g. "0.8" = 80% of strike; min from auction_info)

issuanceCurrency.description: declared issuance currency, ISO 4217 numeric (e.g. 949 = TRY); any 1..999 code

referenceCurrency.description: reference currency the bid prices in, ISO 4217 numeric; must be one the day prices (auction_info)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_bid_reveal
tools.description: Reveal a committed Intex bid: re-derives the same signature from (worldwideDay, units, rate, currencies) and submits revealBid; the escrow calculates units * protocol-6 PROMIS load * rate / 1e6, then converts that result by 1e12 into native-18 WCOEN for the lock. The reference currency must be one the day prices, the issuance currency any 1..999 code. Auto-approves the escrow first if the allowance is short. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

rate.description: bid rate as a fraction of strike, 0..1 (e.g. "0.8" = 80% of strike; min from auction_info)

issuanceCurrency.description: declared issuance currency, ISO 4217 numeric (e.g. 949 = TRY); any 1..999 code

referenceCurrency.description: reference currency the bid prices in, ISO 4217 numeric; must be one the day prices (auction_info)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_bid_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a committed bid for a worldwide day before the reveal stage. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_claim_commit_bond
tools.description: Reclaim an entry bond left behind by a no-reveal commit. Permissionless and always pays the stored bidder: a cancelled (red-day) auction releases immediately, otherwise the bond is claimable only 24 hours past revealEnd. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

bidder.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: auction_claim_refund
tools.description: Collect what a bid lock still holds and close it: a winner's change over the clearing price, a loser's whole principal once its day closed, or the whole principal 72h after the lock when no refund instructions reached this chain (e.g. it missed the clearing deadline). Read the amount and the date first with auction_bids_by_owner. Permissionless and always pays the stored bidder. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

bidder.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_payment_allowance
tools.description: Payment-token allowance granted to the EscrowAdapter and the account's balance, with token decimals/symbol.

account.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_payment_approve
tools.description: Manually approve the EscrowAdapter to pull the payment token. Usually unnecessary - auction_bid_reveal auto-approves what it needs. Pass amount in token units (e.g. "100") or max=true. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

max.description: approve the maximum instead of a fixed amount

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_bridge_quote
tools.description: Bridge native fee to move an Intex NFT from BSC to outbe. Bridging is owner-initiated at every stage: to any recipient while the series is Issued or Qualified, and to yourself only once it is Called, up to its settlementDeadline (read it with intex_series_info).

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_bridge_send
tools.description: Bridge an Intex NFT from BSC to outbe, where settlement happens - nothing moves it for you, so a position left on BSC past the series settlementDeadline can no longer be settled at all. Works at every stage: to any recipient while Issued or Qualified, and to yourself only once the series is Called (ownership is frozen then, so a recipient other than you is refused). The bridge burns your token directly (role-gated), so no approval is needed. Auto-quotes the native fee (paid as value), which you pay in the source chain's native token. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_settle
tools.description: Settlement step 1: pay the strike and turn Issued Intexes into Settled (Promis is mined later via intex_promis_mine). Pays in `token`, one of the tokens intex_settlement_tokens lists: the tool quotes the units, approves IntexFactory for that cost if the allowance is short, and settles at the quoted snapshot. Defaults to your own wallet; pass owner to pay for someone else's position. Allowed once the series has qualified (voluntary; see `qualified` in intex_series_info) or is Called (forced, within the call period). The Settled token (soulbound) stays with the owner whoever pays, and only the owner can mine its Promis. Settlement only ever happens on outbe: a position sitting on BSC has to be brought over with intex_bridge_send first, and that has to land before the series settlementDeadline. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

token.description: settlement token address, one listed by intex_settlement_tokens

owner.description: owner of the units (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_settlement_tokens
tools.description: Tokens you can settle a series with and what settling `units` of it costs in each; intex_settle pays that cost in the token you pick. The chain floors the whole operation once, so quote the units you will actually settle. An issuance-currency cost holds only until the next whole UTC hour (its `snapshotId` changes then), so settle within that hour or quote again.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_promis_mine
tools.description: Settlement step 2: burn your Settled Intexes and mine Promis to your own wallet (run intex_settle first). The proof-of-work nonce is computed locally; you give only series and units. Requires OUTBE_PRIVATE_KEY.

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)

tools.name: intex_promis_balance
tools.description: Encrypted Promis balance for an address on outbe; decrypt it locally with the account's Promis view key.

account.description: 0x address to query (default: the configured signer)

network.description: network: outbe, outbe-testnet, bsc-testnet, sepolia or a chain id (outbe is the connected node)
